block-handbooktext-eoven:
The Electric Oven can completely replace the standard furnace. Automatically turns off when the baking process is complete. No more burning!
Supports automatic loading and unloading using hoppers.
block-handbooktext-heater:
A small heat source that can provide a temperature bonus to planting beds, fruit trees, regular trees (seeds and saplings), berry bushes, and beehives inside a greenhouse. At full power, one such heater provides +5°C per 100 blocks of the greenhouse's interior volume. This volume includes the planting beds themselves. The effect of heaters can be cumulative: the total bonus can be viewed on any heater. The bonus information updates as soon as one of the plants recalculates.
Growing fruit trees won't become easier: you still need to follow all their growth cycles, so you'll need to use heaters to adjust the resulting temperature according to the tree's current stage. Cuttings need to overwinter for several days at low temperatures, then gradually increase the temperature until they take root (or not). After that, you can further increase the internal temperature to comfortable values for that tree, and it will begin to bloom, fruit, etc. Each tree has its own temperature ranges, so be careful not to harm it. Once it has fruited, you can force the tree back into dormancy. The cycle can then be repeated as needed.
block-handbooktext-eheatcannon:
A powerful heat source that can provide a temperature bonus to planting beds, fruit trees, regular trees (seeds and saplings), berry bushes, and beehives inside a greenhouse. At full power, one such heater provides +50°C per 100 blocks of the greenhouse's interior volume. This volume includes the planting beds themselves. The effect of heaters can be cumulative: the total bonus can be viewed on any heater. The bonus information updates as soon as one of the plants recalculates.
Growing fruit trees won't become easier: you still need to follow all their growth cycles, so you'll need to use heaters to adjust the resulting temperature according to the tree's current stage. Cuttings need to overwinter for several days at low temperatures, then gradually increase the temperature until they take root (or not). After that, you can further increase the internal temperature to comfortable values for that tree, and it will begin to bloom, fruit, etc. Each tree has its own temperature ranges, so be careful not to harm it. Once it has fruited, you can force the tree back into dormancy. The cycle can then be repeated as needed.
block-handbooktext-elamp: A good light source that consumes electrical energy.
block-handbooktext-elamp_small: A light source that consumes electrical energy.
block-handbooktext-nasteniy_fonar: A variant of an electric lamp with wall mounting.
block-handbooktext-stolb_fonar: A variant of an electric lamp for street lighting.
block-handbooktext-ehorn:
The Electric Forge can completely replace the standard blacksmith's forge.

Maximum heating temperature: 1100 °C.
Supports automatic loading and unloading using hoppers.
block-handbooktext-charger:
The Charging Station allows you to charge accumulators and devices with built-in batteries.
Supports automatic loading and unloading using hoppers.
block-handbooktext-estove:
The Electric Stove can completely replace the standard campfire.
Supports automatic loading and unloading using hoppers.

Maximum stove heating temperature: 1350 °C.
freezer-over-help: Open the door and place food inside to preserve it.
block-handbooktext-efridge:
The Electric Refrigerator allows food to be stored longer.

Storage slots: 6.
Food spoilage rate: 0.1x.
Can retain cold inside for up to 6 in-game hours after losing power.
block-handbooktext-efreezer:
The Electric Freezer allows food to be stored for a very long time. Can also store one animal carcass from the Butchering mod.

Storage slots: 6.
Food spoilage rate: 0.025x.
Can retain cold inside for up to 6 in-game hours after losing power.
block-handbooktext-efence: Good protection against unwanted guests. Inflicts electrical damage on contact. Does not consume energy but requires connection to an electrical circuit to operate.
block-handbooktext-ehotspringsgenerator: A generator that uses the energy of hot springs to produce electricity. Must be surrounded by hot springs on all sides. Efficiency can be increased by placing Heat Exchangers near the generator. Having multiple generators nearby significantly reduces efficiency.
hotsprings-not-surrounded: Must be surrounded by hot springs
block-handbooktext-eheatexchanger: A Heat Exchanger that must be placed adjacent to a Hot Springs Generator (including diagonal cells). Each heat exchanger increases the generator's efficiency, from 5% with none to 100% with 7 heat exchangers.
heatexchanger-placement-hint: Must be placed adjacent to a Hot Springs Generator
